title: Public sector
description: Adapt reviews to software built for or sold to EU public sector bodies: administrations, local authorities and public institutions.
context: Ask the account owner whether the customer is a public sector body whose websites and mobile applications fall under Directive (EU) 2016/2102, and which national transposition applies, such as the RGAA in France. This sector preselects the public-sector-accessibility pattern and, for France, the france-rgaa-accessibility pattern: decline it for a customer outside France.
Read the accessibility and other technical specifications of the contract (Directive 2014/24/EU Art. 42) before planning a change to a delivered product.
Name who updates the customer's accessibility statement and answers its feedback mechanism (Directive (EU) 2016/2102 Art. 7).

NIS 2 lists public administration in its Annex I: ask the security owner whether the customer is an essential or important entity, and select the nis2-essential-entity pattern when the product is in its scope.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2016/2102 on the accessibility of the websites and mobile applications of public sector bodies
